apps.title: Plonk
apps.seoTitle: Plonk — Free Online Floor Planner (No Sign-up)
apps.tagline: Draw a room, plonk in furniture, see if the sofa fits.
apps.description: Plonk is a free online floor planner. Draw rooms and walls with exact dimensions, drag in beds, sofas, tables and kitchen units, and export your plan as PNG or SVG. Runs in your browser, no account needed.
